suitability_reason: Decided issues are sec. 274(d) substantiation of car/truck and travel expenses and a sec. 6651(a)(1) addition sustained for failure to prove reasonable cause; no mechanical test decided beyond undisputed lateness.

taxpayer.notes: Performing blues musician and manager of band 'Twice As Good'; trips to Japan for music-industry research. Filing status not stated.

adjustments: disallowed Schedule C deductions incl. car and truck ($11,949 2018; $19,034 2019) and travel ($11,002 2018; $8,400 2019)
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Car/truck and travel deductions; 2018 late-filing addition
conceded: Respondent conceded contract labor adjustments for 2018 and 2019
Respondent conceded car and truck expenses of $2,409 (2018) and $2,694 (2019) at trial, and further amounts post-trial
Respondent conceded the sec. 6662(a) penalties for 2018 and 2019

findings_of_fact.fact: Schedules C reported car/truck $11,949 and travel $11,002 (2018); car/truck $19,034 and travel $8,400 (2019)
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner’s 2018 Schedule C, Profit or Loss From Business, reported $11,949 in car and truck expenses and $11,002 in travel expenses.

findings_of_fact.fact: No contemporaneous mileage log; log created after the years; some records destroyed in Oct. 2018 fire
findings_of_fact.snippet: He did not maintain a contemporaneous mileage log but created a mileage log sometime after the years in issue
petitioner is entitled to claim 9,074 miles for tax year 2018 and 11,896 miles for tax year 2019

findings_of_fact.fact: Did not perform, sign a contract, or report income in Japan
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner did not sign a contract to perform, did not perform in Japan, and did not report any income

findings_of_fact.fact: Insufficient evidence corroborating business reasons for travel
findings_of_fact.snippet: he did not provide sufficient evidence to corroborate his business reasons for travel.

findings_of_fact.fact: 2018 return filed July 14, 2019 without extension; 2019 return timely
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner filed his Form 1040, U.S. Individual Income Tax Return for tax year 2018 on July 14, 2019.

findings_of_fact.fact: No evidence of reasonable cause for late filing
findings_of_fact.snippet: petitioner failed to introduce evidence showing that there was reasonable cause for filing his return late.

issues.question: (Schedule C vehicle expenses, sec. 162/274(d)) Is petitioner entitled to deduct car and truck expenses of $11,949 (2018) and $19,034 (2019) beyond respondent's concessions?
issues.holding: Allowed only the conceded mileage (9,074 miles 2018; 11,896 miles 2019); remainder disallowed for lack of strict substantiation

issues.question: (Schedule C travel expenses, sec. 162(a)(2)/274(d)) Is petitioner entitled to deduct travel expenses of $11,002 (2018) and $8,400 (2019)?
Is petitioner liable for the sec. 6651(a)(1) addition of $1,588 for 2018?
issues.holding: Liable; return filed late without extension; no evidence of reasonable cause (personal hardships)
issues.computable_reason: Lateness is mechanical, but outcome turned on rejection of asserted reasonable cause for lack of evidence

decision.text: Decision will be entered under Rule 155.
decision.summary: Car/truck deductions limited to conceded mileage; travel deductions disallowed; 2018 6651(a)(1) addition sustained; 6662(a) penalties conceded

notes: Stipulation of facts as supplemented (Second Supplement added royalty records, with further post-trial car/truck concessions). Court found ongoing music business (fn. 5) but did not decide sec. 195 startup issue. Mileage rate not stated.
